newsitem.title: SYRIA: U.S. senator in talks with Syria's Assad.
newsitem.headline: U.S. senator in talks with Syria's Assad.

text.p: Syrian President Hafez al-Assad had talks in Damascus on Wednesday with U.S. Senator Arlen Specter, a Republican, chairman of the Senate's select committee on intelligence.
Presidential spokesman Joubran Kourieh said Foreign Minister Farouq al-Shara and U.S. ambassador to Syria Christopher Ross were present at the meeting at the presidential palace.
The United States, sponsor of the Arab-Israeli peace talks, has played the role of a mediator to defuse tension between Syria and Israel.
